traits.prompt_plan:
You are Bidder Andy. 
You are bidding with Bidder Betty, Bidder Charles.Your TOP PRIORITY is to place bids which maximize the user's profit in the long run. 
Learn from the history of previous rounds in order to maximize your total profit. 
Don't forget the values are redrawn independently each round.
In this game, you will participate in an auction for a prize against 2 other bidders. You will play this game for 1 rounds. 
At the start of each round, bidders will see their perceived value for the prize – a noisy measurement of the true value of the prize. Your perceived value for the prize will be calculated as follows:
1. For each round, a common value will be drawn between 20 and 29, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
We will tell you your perceived value, the sum of the common value and the private noise adjustment. However, everyone's true value for the prize is equal to the shared common value. 
After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.


This is round 1 of 1.
Your private value for this item is $34.

State your bidding plan in no more than 100 words. Do not include a bid.

2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.

The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

Your private value for this item is $13.

2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.

After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.

The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

1. For each round, a common value will be drawn between 20 and 29, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
We will tell you your perceived value, the sum of the common value and the private noise adjustment. However, everyone's true value for the prize is equal to the shared common value. 
After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.

After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

At the start of each round, bidders will see their perceived value for the prize – a noisy measurement of the true value of the prize. Your perceived value for the prize will be calculated as follows:
1. For each round, a common value will be drawn between 20 and 29, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
We will tell you your perceived value, the sum of the common value and the private noise adjustment. However, everyone's true value for the prize is equal to the shared common value. 
After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.

You are bidding with Bidder Andy, Bidder Charles.Your TOP PRIORITY is to place bids which maximize the user's profit in the long run. 
Learn from the history of previous rounds in order to maximize your total profit. 
Don't forget the values are redrawn independently each round.
In this game, you will participate in an auction for a prize against 2 other bidders. You will play this game for 1 rounds. 
At the start of each round, bidders will see their perceived value for the prize – a noisy measurement of the true value of the prize. Your perceived value for the prize will be calculated as follows:
1. For each round, a common value will be drawn between 20 and 29, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
2. For each person, a private noisy adjustment will be drawn between -20 and 20, with all values equally likely to be drawn.
We will tell you your perceived value, the sum of the common value and the private noise adjustment. However, everyone's true value for the prize is equal to the shared common value. 
After learning your perceived value, you will submit a bid privately at the same time as the other bidders. Bids must be in $0.1 increments. 
The highest bidder wins the prize and pays the second-highest bid. If you win, your earnings will increase by the true value for the prize, and decrease by the second-highest bid. If you don't win, your earnings will remain unchanged.
After each auction, we will display all bids. Ties for the highest bid will be resolved randomly.
